headline: Bitstamp Flips To A 58.0 Million Dollar Outflow From A 212.5 Million Dollar Intake
narrative: Bitstamp reversed to a 58.0 million dollar outflow over 24 hours, from a 212.5 million dollar intake, which means dollars left a venue where holders can sell after arriving there on the prior print. Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to 1,423.2 million dollars, 0.5117 percent of the 278.1 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,639.9 million dollars. Bitget remained the largest intake at 874.6 million dollars, Binance took in 323.4 million dollars, and Gate took in 216.0 million dollars, while OKX posted a 79.6 million dollar outflow, the largest departure.
author: jordan
